title: Seal Crack
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji forcibly broke through the seal, a blurry image exploded in his Mental Sea—it was his own death prophecy, and the third figure appearing in the scene was...

text.content: Before Chen Nian could finish speaking, Chen Ji's Brow Center suddenly throbbed. That Tianji Record Fragment that had been dormant deep within his Mental Sea let out a piercing hum at this moment, as if a beast imprisoned for ten thousand years had caught the scent of blood. Excruciating pain surged from the depths of his Mental Sea like a tide, his vision went dark, and his body stumbled backward involuntarily. "Brother!" Chen Nian cried out, her slender hands gripping his arm, yet in that moment of contact, she felt a violent force rush through her Blood Pulse into her body—that was the fragmentary information escaping from the loosened Tianji Record seal. The seal had cracked. The fissure was expanding.

Within the Mental Sea, Chen Ji felt as though he stood at the storm's center. The Tianji Record Fragment floated in the Void, golden patterns on the fourth-layer seal visibly crumbling, each crack accompanied by soul-searing agony. "Steady your mind!" Mo Xiansheng's voice came from deep within the Fragment, carrying unprecedented gravity, "Blood Pulse Resonance is a double-edged sword—your sister's Heavenly Fate Lock-Key Constitution is catalyzing the seal, but it will also drag you into an uncontrollable abyss!" Chen Ji gritted his teeth, nails digging deep into his palms. Blood threads began seeping at the edges of his vision—that was the warning of Mental Sea overload. Yet at this moment, a shattered image forcefully invaded his consciousness—a dilapidated ancestral hall, flickering candlelight, a man's back kneeling on the ground, blood gushing from his chest.

The image was too real, so real that Chen Ji could almost smell the blood filling the air. He saw the man struggle to raise his head, lips moving, seemingly saying something—yet in the next instant, a massive Eye descended from the heavens, its pupil flowing with indifferent Order Power. That was... the Eye of Heavenly Way! The man's voice finally came through,断续却字字诛心: "Ji'er... don't... trust... Heaven..." Before the words finished, that Eye slightly focused, and the man dissolved into scattered starlight, vanishing into the Void. Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, knuckles cracking. Father's death was never an accident. And he had spent整整十年, only glimpsing this tragic truth from the defective seal.

dialogue.content: "Brother! What did you see? I saw it too just now—lots of light spots, and a huge eye! What is that?"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer his sister's question, because at this very moment, the second strange change occurred. Outside the inn's window, the originally clear night sky suddenly darkened, and a dense black mist silently spread forth, within which a graceful figure could be vaguely seen hovering in mid-air. Ye Qing. Her妖异的紫眸 pierced through the window lattice, directly locking onto Chen Ji's direction, her complexion even paler than Chen Ji's. "That aura..." her voice rarely trembled, "is the residual mark of the Eye of Heavenly Way. Chen Ji, what forbidden thing did you touch?" Three factions formed a delicate standoff in this cramped inn. Chen Nian stood at Chen Ji's side, her Heavenly Fate Lock-Key power causing her to resonate with the Tianji Record; Ye Qing floated outside the window, her Demonic Path Mist concealing her movements but unable to hide the shock in her eyes; and Chen Ji himself was enduring the pain of his Mental Sea tearing apart and the shock of his father's death truth.

dialogue.content: "I sensed... something awakening within the seal's core. That isn't ordinary power, it's something beyond comprehension. You must stop immediately, otherwise—"

text.content: The agony within the Mental Sea grew increasingly intense. The fissure in the fourth-layer seal had expanded to the point where the power sealed within could leak out, and Chen Ji could clearly feel that power's terror—it was a vast information flow sufficient to overturn his current understanding. If left unchecked, he might be blown apart in an instant; if forcibly sealed, the seal's backlash could just as easily shatter his soul. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time carrying some kind of cryptic hint: "Master, what is sealed within the fourth-layer is one of the Tianji Record's core functions—【Causal Trace】. It allows you to see the complete causal chain behind any event, at the cost of... you must endure all the pain of the observed one's death instant." Chen Ji closed his eyes, rapidly calculating in his heart. Risky breakthrough, to obtain key clues to his father's death truth; Steady hiding, to consolidate current cultivation before slowly planning for the future; or... Borrowing Power to Unseal, using Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist to conceal aura, partially unsealing without alerting the Eye of Heavenly Way.

choice.prompt: The agony within the Mental Sea continued, the seal's fissure growing larger. Three paths lie before you, each leading to entirely different futures. You choose—

choices.visible_reward: Unlock the [Causal Trace] core function, obtain key evidence of Father's death truth
choices.risk_hint: May trigger tracking by the Eye of Heavenly Way, Mental Sea risk of collapse

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, pupils burning with resolute flames. He formed seals with both hands, the Tianji Record Fragment rotating at high speed within his Mental Sea, golden seals cracking like thin ice. "Since the fissure has opened, then—break!" He bit his tongue, spitting a mouthful of Essence Blood toward the Fragment. The instant the Essence Blood touched the Fragment, the seal collapsed with a thunderous boom, an information torrent sufficient to tear apart souls instantly flooding his consciousness.

The pain exceeded his imagination. Chen Ji's body convulsed violently, blood seeping from all seven orifices,整个人摇摇欲坠. But at the edge of consciousness collapse, he finally saw that stored image—Father had hidden a wisp of residual soul within the Tianji Record before death, waiting for the day his son could find it. And that descending Eye of Heavenly Way, deep within its pupil, reflected the silhouette of... the Tianqing Sect Master!

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the agony within his Mental Sea. He closed his eyes, weaving his remaining divine sense into a delicate net, slowly covering that expanding fissure. The process was like dancing on a blade's edge—too much force would tear more seals, too little couldn't stem the collapse.

After one incense stick's time, the fissure was finally barely sealed, but noticeably several fractions wider than before. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of commendation: "Master has excellent composure. As the saying goes, preservation is paramount. Only... thirty percent of the information in the seal's core has already been lost. Unsealing it next time will be much harder." Chen Ji opened his eyes, a cold smile curling at his lips: "Thirty percent? Enough. I've already seen the most crucial part." He glanced at that floating purple figure outside the window, a glint of brilliance flashing in his eyes—Ye Qing, perhaps it was time to let her in on some things.

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, meeting those purple eyes through the window. "Ye Qing, come in." His voice was eerily calm, "I need your Demonic Path Mist." The next instant, the window shattered silently, Ye Qing's figure like a specter darting into the room. She didn't waste words, her slender hand waving, a thick layer of black mist instantly enveloping Chen Ji's Mental Sea—the mist as if alive, coiling around the Tianji Record Fragment, wrapping its aura layer upon layer.

Under the Demonic Path Mist's cover, Chen Ji activated the seal once more. This time, although the agony remained intense, it was within his tolerable range. He saw more—the complete scene of Father resisting the Eye of Heavenly Way before death was presented, and within that massive Eye's pupil, besides the Tianqing Sect Master's silhouette, was another blurry figure. That figure... seemed to be someone extremely familiar to him. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, looking at Chen Nian beside him, a complex expression flickering in his gaze. Sister, just how deep into this maelstrom have you been pulled?

choices.memory_label: 借力夜清解封，欠下人情债

text.content: At the exact moment Chen Ji made his choice, deep within a certain secret realm thousands of miles away, a pair of indifferent eyes slowly opened. There was no eye socket, no face, only a chaotic Void, with a massive Eye flowing with Order Power suspended in its center. "Interesting." That voice had no source, yet seemed to echo from all directions simultaneously, "The fourth-layer seal loosened at this particular juncture. Coincidence, or... is someone playing a game?" The massive Eye slightly turned, its pupil's depths reflecting an image of the inn where Chen Ji was, and within that image, an隐约可见的紫色身影. "The Holy Sect's girl is involved too? Interesting. It seems the chess pieces of this generation are more restless than the previous one." The massive Eye closed once more, yet that gaze extended like a silk thread, silently approaching toward Chen Ji's direction.

dialogue.content: "What did you see? Just now your expression... I've never seen you look at me like that."

text.content: Chen Ji didn't immediately answer Ye Qing's question. His gaze shifted from his sister to the pitch-black night sky outside the window, to the direction of that seemingly omnipresent Eye of Heavenly Way. "I saw my father's death." He finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm, "And I saw some... things I'm not yet certain I should tell you." Ye Qing's brow furrowed slightly, acutely sensing the reservation in Chen Ji's words. She didn't press, simply waiting quietly. The atmosphere among the three pressed down to the extreme. And just then, Chen Nian suddenly clutched her head, letting out a pained groan—the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key power within her had resonated with the Tianji Record at this moment, that resonance carrying an indescribable terror, rapidly spreading toward unknown depths.

"Nian'er!" Chen Ji grabbed his stumbling sister, his divine sense probing into her body. The next instant, his pupils contracted sharply—deep within Chen Nian's Mental Sea, a faint golden thread coiled, its source pointing unmistakably in the direction of... Tianqing Sect! "When did this happen?" His voice turned icy cold, "Who did this to you?" Chen Nian shook her head in bewilderment: "I don't know... I really don't know... It's been there ever since I can remember..." Ye Qing leaned close to observe, her complexion suddenly changing: "This is... a Fate Brand. Someone branded a mark deep within her soul when she was young. Once activated, your sister will become a permanent beacon for locating the Tianji Record." Chen Ji's fists slowly clenched, knuckles cracking. "Tianqing Sect... Ling Yuan..." he murmured that name, a fierce killing intent flickering in his eyes. A decade of scheming, and from the very beginning, he was the prey.

dialogue.content: "Brother, did I drag you into this? I'm sorry... I really didn't know..."

text.content: Chen Ji reached out and wiped the tears from his sister's eyes, his touch gentle yet conveying unshakable resolve. "Why are you crying?" His voice was low, "This brand, rather than being a shackle, is a clue. Ling Yuan thought he controlled everything, but every step he takes exposes his weaknesses." He turned to look at Ye Qing, his eyes gleaming with calculation, "Saint Maiden, I have a proposal. Would you like to see what happens when the Eye of Heavenly Way discovers its chess piece has gone out of control?" Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, a spark of interest flashing in her purple eyes: "You want to draw out the snake? But don't forget, once the brand on your sister activates, you become the live target." A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips, that smile holding not a trace of warmth: "A live target? No, it's bait. The identity of hunter and hunted has always depended on who fires first."

dialogue.content: "You're insane. This is dragging the entire Tianqing Sect into the water, do you understand what this means? The three major sects, the Demonic Path, even... the Eye of Heavenly Way itself, will all be alerted."

text.content: "I know." Chen Ji's voice was calm as water, "But the chess game has reached mid-game, continuing to hide will only give opponents more time to scheme. Instead of waiting for them to make moves, let me be the one to ignite this fuse." He paused, his gaze profound, "Moreover, I just obtained a crucial piece of information from the seal—when the Eye of Heavenly Way descended to the mortal realm, it wasn't without cost. Every large-scale manifestation consumes the Order Power it has accumulated over ten thousand years. If we can make it expose itself a few more times here..." He didn't finish, but Ye Qing already understood his intent. This was using himself as bait to deplete the Eye of Heavenly Way's power! A gleam of wonder flashed in this woman's eyes—THIS was a true chess master; not despising any stream, therefore could achieve greatness.

Within the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, this time carrying a rare sigh: "Master, are you certain you wish to take this path? The Eye of Heavenly Way isn't an ordinary enemy, it..." "What is it?" Chen Ji asked in his heart. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, finally uttering four characters: "Tianji Record's本体." Chen Ji's body froze instantly. The Tianji Record's本体? Then the Fragment in his hands... Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense his shock, continuing: "The Eye of Heavenly Way is the result of the Tianji Record's differentiation in ancient times. It pursued Order and Control, choosing to become the Will of Heaven; while the本体 pursued Freedom and Change, shattering into countless fragments scattered across the mortal realm. The one in your hands, Master, is merely a fragment of the body's fragment." This truth was like a basin of cold water, bringing Chen Ji back to his senses momentarily.

So from the very beginning, his confrontation with the Eye of Heavenly Way was a battle of the same origin. The stronger the Fragment in his hands, the more the Eye of Heavenly Way's本体 would fear it; and every probe by the Eye of Heavenly Way toward him might be an attempt to find opportunities to recover the fragments. "So it killed my father." Chen Ji said in his heart, his tone cold and fierce, "Because he possessed the Fragment but refused to hand it over." Mo Xiansheng didn't deny it. "Master, your father was the previous generation's Tianji Record holder. He discovered the truth, so he chose to seal the Fragment, leaving it for you." Chen Ji closed his eyes, taking a deep breath. When he opened them again, the fury had been replaced by ice-cold, bone-deep killing intent. "Fine. Very well. Since it's so, let this battle of the same origin end in this generation."

Ye Qing and Chen Nian only saw Chen Ji's expression undergo several changes in an instant—from shock to anger, from anger to contemplation, from contemplation to... a coldness that was foreign to both of them. "Chen Ji?" Ye Qing试探性地唤道. Chen Ji turned to look at her, a slight arc appearing at the corner of his mouth: "The plan has changed. Before drawing out the snake, I need to make some preparations first." He walked to the window, pushing it open, night wind rushing in, stirring his disheveled hair. "Ye Qing, I need you to spread a message throughout the entire cultivation world within three days—that the Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple Chen Ji has incidentally obtained an ancient supreme treasure, and will publicly display it at the Sect Tournament." Ye Qing's eyes lit up: "You want to use yourself as live bait, drawing all major forces to gather at Tianqing Sect?"

dialogue.content: "Not just a live bait. A chess piece capable of pivoting the entire game. When everyone is focused on the Tianji Record, that's when the true killing move falls."

text.content: As the words fell, an诡异波动 suddenly came from outside the window. Ye Qing's expression slightly changed, her slender hand waving, the Demonic Path Mist instantly sealing the entire guest room tightly. "Something is watching us." She lowered her voice, a hint of solemnity flashing in her purple eyes, "Not ordinary scrying techniques, it's... causal-level tracing." Chen Ji's heart tightened—Causal Tracing, wasn't that the core function he had just glimpsed from the seal? The Eye of Heavenly Way had already sensed the anomaly, attempting to lock onto his position through causal threads. "Time is running out." He said quietly, his voice carrying resolve, "Three days is too long, we start tomorrow." He looked at Chen Nian, his gaze complex: "Nian'er, are you afraid?" Chen Nian shook her head vigorously, her tear-streaked face showing a stubborn expression: "As long as I'm with Brother, I'm not afraid of anything."

Chen Ji reached out, gently rubbing the top of his sister's head. This gesture was completely different from the calculating, ruthless demeanor from before; in this moment, he was simply an ordinary elder brother who wanted to protect his sister. "Alright." He said, his voice low yet firm, "Then tomorrow, let the entire cultivation world see what kind of storm the so-called waste disciple can truly stir." Outside the window, the night was deep as ink. Thousands of miles away, that massive Eye suspended in the chaotic Void slowly opened once more, its pupil's depths reflecting Chen Ji's figure.
